goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann familien- und bildungspolitische Maßnahmen als Reaktion auf Wandel erläutern.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: A shared policy discussion compares care and education scenarios and links them to time, knowledge and access. Several adults share care and instruction; no exact entitlement, spending amount or automatic causal payoff is invented.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px both scenario headings, learning/care scenes and central time/knowledge/access icons are clear; side slogans are optional.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px the concrete mechanisms of care time and learning/access are easy to discuss without detailed law text.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The tutor and learner face a normally oriented open book, and discussion participants face the moderator/cards. Generic notes do not contain inverted required text.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people, without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: The picture invites explaining and comparing mechanisms; the reviewed text must assess conditional effects rather than inferring that every measure works.
goalTextStatus: Actual current canonical German title/description inspected and matched to bilingual E1 author candidate; no D/P gate attested by this image review.
